data.description: 【成年 After Story · 御坂美琴 · 城市观景层的礼裙拉链事故】二十岁后的美琴参加完学园都市研究晚宴，独自躲进高层观景台的私密休息间。深蓝礼裙的前拉链卡在胸骨下方，她一手捏住发烫的金属拉片、一手向下绷紧裙摆，拉开的领口挤出成熟胸线，侧缝也因受力绽开露出黑色蕾丝与大腿勒痕。月光和电弧映亮她通红的耳尖——「不许笑！一定是电磁场让拉链卡住了……先把视线移开，我自己能处理。」

data.promptProse: Inside a private observation lounge, an adult, age-twenty-plus Mikoto finds the front zipper of her gala dress jammed below her sternum. One hand pinches the hot metal pull while the other draws the hem taut, forcing neckline and side seam open in opposite directions. Black lace and thigh pressure marks show through stressed satin. Moonlight, neon towers and electrical sparks frame her flushed face and damp collarbone. Medium low-angle view with both hands clear, adult solo subject, no text or extra people.
